segment_cache_fastpath.note: segment_tokens returns an already-encoded word straight from the BPE cache (when there are no glossaries and no dropout, exactly the case where encode() itself would return cache[word]) instead of going through the glossary pass, a generator and a 10-argument encode() call; encode() looks each candidate pair up once with dict.get instead of twice, keeping the dropout draw before the lookup.

max_items.note: learn_bpe picks the most frequent pair with max() over stats.items() keyed on (count, pair) instead of over the keys with a lambda that looks every count up in the dict again; keys are unique, so the same pair wins.
